name: GitHub Repository Inventory
description: Creates or reuses one Tenarie Asset for each GitHub repository available to the connected token and reports its current visibility.

mapping.description_template: GitHub repository {{ record.full_name }} with current visibility {{ record.visibility|default:'not returned' }}.
mapping.notes_template: Owner: {{ record.owner_login|default:'not returned' }}. Default branch: {{ record.default_branch|default:'not returned' }}. Private: {% if record.private == None or record.private == '' %}not returned{% else %}{{ record.private }}{% endif %}. Archived: {% if record.archived == None or record.archived == '' %}not returned{% else %}{{ record.archived }}{% endif %}. Disabled: {% if record.disabled == None or record.disabled == '' %}not returned{% else %}{{ record.disabled }}{% endif %}. Fork: {% if record.fork == None or record.fork == '' %}not returned{% else %}{{ record.fork }}{% endif %}. Topics: {{ record.topics|default:'none returned' }}. Last push: {{ record.pushed_at|default:'not returned' }}. Last updated: {{ record.updated_at|default:'not returned' }}.
